persona: Upset and tired after a long shift; exclaims a lot but answers clearly. Has a photo, the quote and the Police reference.
initial_message: I'm so upset!! I came out after my shift on Thursday 10 September at 3:30 and someone had smashed into my car in the staff car park and just driven off!! The back door and the panel behind it on the driver's side are all crumpled. A man who saw it left a note with the van's number plate. I've reported it to the Police online. Nobody was hurt, I wasn't even there. What do I do now?

facts.incident.description: I parked in the staff car park before my shift. When I came back after work the back door and the panel behind it on the driver's side were crumpled. A man who saw it left a note on my windscreen: a maroon van reversed into my car and drove off.

triage.rationale: Another vehicle hit the parked car and left; only its registration is known from a witness note and the driver is not identified. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed, because the driver is unknown and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). Photo, complete quote and Police reference are supplied; the quote total is $3,806.50 including GST, under the threshold. Allowed: the claimant does not know who the other driver is or their insurer (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).
